titleTr: Sınıf ortamı: çok küçük mü, yeterince büyük mü?

explainTr: 'Too' 'fazla' demektir ve olumsuz bir sonuç taşır: The room is too small. (Bu yüzden sorun var.) Yapısı: too + sıfat (+ to + fiil): too noisy to study.
'Enough' 'yeterince' demektir. Sıfattan sonra gelir: big enough, old enough. İsimden önce gelir: enough chairs, enough time.
Eşitlik için as + sıfat + as: Hafsa is as tall as Linda. Olumsuz: not as + sıfat + as, yani 'kadar ... değil': This room is not as big as that one.
grammar.compareTr: Türkçede 'çok küçük' hem 'very' hem 'too' anlamına gelebilir. İngilizcede ayrıdır: very small = çok küçük (sadece bilgi), too small = fazla küçük (sorun var). Ayrıca Türkçe 'yeterince büyük' der; İngilizcede 'enough' sıfattan SONRA gelir: big enough.

reading.title: A crowded classroom
reading.text:
On Tuesday, Hafsa substituted in Mr. Walker's third-grade room. When she walked in, she stopped for a second. There were twenty-eight desks, and the room was too small for all of them. The aisles were so narrow that the children could not walk easily.

"This room is not as big as Ms. Park's room," Hafsa said to herself. "It is too crowded."

The students were also quite noisy. The hallway was loud, and the voices in the room made it too hard to listen. A few children said that they could not hear her. Hafsa clapped her hands twice, as Mr. Walker's sub plan suggested. The class became quiet.

During the first activity, Hafsa noticed another problem. Some desks were too close to the heater, so those students felt too warm. Others sat near the window, and the sun was too bright for them to read. They were not comfortable.

At lunch, Hafsa talked to Mr. Brown. "The room is not big enough for twenty-eight students," she said. "Could we move some desks to the hallway wall?"

Mr. Brown smiled. "That's a good idea. The principal has been asking for suggestions."

After lunch, they moved four desks. The room was still not spacious, but it was much better. The students were calmer, and Hafsa was happier.

questions.whyTr: Metin: 'the room was too small for all of them'.

questions.whyTr: Metin: 'the sun was too bright for them to read'.

questions.q: What did Hafsa suggest to Mr. Brown?
options: Move some desks to the wall
questions.whyTr: Metin: 'Could we move some desks to the hallway wall?'

questions.q: How was the room after the change?
questions.whyTr: Metin: 'still not spacious, but it was much better'.

writing.promptTr: Bir sınıfı anlat: neyi çok küçük/gürültülü, neyi yeterince büyük/rahat değil? too, enough ve (not) as ... as kullan.
writing.promptEn: Describe a classroom. Use too, enough and (not) as ... as.
writing.model: Dear Mr. Brown, I want to tell you about Mr. Walker's classroom. It is too small for twenty-eight desks, and the aisles are too narrow. The hallway is too noisy, so the students cannot listen well. The chairs are not as comfortable as the chairs in Ms. Park's room. The windows are big enough, but the sun is too bright in the afternoon. I think we need a bigger room or fewer desks. Thank you for your help. Best regards, Hafsa
checklistTr: Too + sıfat, sıfat + enough sıralarını doğru kullandın mı?
En az bir 'not as ... as' cümlen var mı?
Enough isimden önce, sıfattan sonra mı?
Cümleler büyük harfle başlıyor ve noktayla bitiyor mu?
